page.content:
Japanese ninja clan Scorpion died trying to avenge.

How Shirai Ryu connects

  • Character: Scorpion — Scorpion is the specter of the slaughtered Shirai Ryu.
  • Faction: Lin Kuei — The Lin Kuei and Shirai Ryu are rival assassin clans.
  • Location: Earthrealm — The Shirai Ryu were an Earthrealm ninja clan before the massacre.

What is Shirai Ryu?

The Shirai Ryu are the rival ninja clan to the Lin Kuei. Their massacre sent Hanzo Hasashi into the Netherrealm as Scorpion.

Key threads lead to Scorpion, Lin Kuei and Earthrealm.
